Interface FastStatsService

All Known Subinterfaces:
ErrorTrackerService, FeatureFlagService
@Internal public interface FastStatsService
A service attached to a FastStatsContext.

Services are created from the factories added to FastStatsContext.Builder.service(java.util.function.Function) and follow the context lifecycle: onStart() runs before the first submission task is scheduled, and onShutdown() runs when the context is shut down.

Optional features such as error tracking and feature flags live in separate artifacts and are attached through this interface.

Since:
0.33.0
